LESSON: EXTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.7: Extensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Extensive Reading, part of Reading in Grade 6 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why is reading important? 2. How can we make reading interesting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. conduct a reader’s theatre to read stories and poems about the parts of body,

2. work jointly to build a vocabulary bank on words picked out from the texts,

3. work jointly to identify the main idea in a text,

4. engage in reading activities for pleasure and understanding at home. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. conduct a reader’s theatre to read stories and poems about the parts of body,
2. work jointly to build a vocabulary bank on words picked out from the texts,
3. work jointly to identify the main idea in a text,
4. engage in reading activities for pleasure and understanding at home. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Extensive Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: This is enhanced as the learner collects information from various sources when engaging in reading activities for

pleasure at home.

• Communication and collaboration: This is enhanced as the learner engages in group decision making to identify the main

idea in a text.

Responsibility: This is promoted as the learner takes up assigned tasks when conducting a reader’s theatre to read stories and

poems about the parts of body.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

hygiene.

Link to Other Learning Areas:
